title: Nutrition and Exercise Journal
description: Daily entries containing food, water and supplements consumed as well as exercises done.

date.description: Date of the entry in YYYY-MM-DD format.

measurements.description: List of measurements of biometric information such as body weight or waist circumference. Measurements are taken right after waking up before breakfast and drinking water.

daily_consumables.description: Separate record of consumed daily dietary supplements and other select items such as water.

u.description: Measurement unit - if not given the unit is metric grams.

meals.description: Record of meals during the day. Sequence assumes breakfast - lunch - dinner, but not always. Assume there is at least 2 hours of break between meal records.

u.description: Measurement unit - if not given the unit is metric grams.

exercises.description: Entries of performed physical exercises during the day.

n.description: Name of the exercise. Ring means gymnastic rings.

res.description: Total resistance in kg, or kg equivalent-rated resistance band. Unless specifically noted, resistance bands are stretched to 150% (equivalent of dumbbells half the bands' rated resistance at peak ROM, example: if 'res' is 60 for band, the effective resistance is 30 kg at peak ROM). 0 means bodyweight only.

restype.description: Tool of resistance applied. Typically it is either dumbbells, resistance bands or bodyweight.

rir.description: Reps in reserve before technical failure - indicative of exercise intensity

rest.description: Number of seconds of rest between sets.

sets.description: Sets with reps. Individual array items are sets, the numbers in the array are the number of reps. For unilateral exercises the rep count is for each side/limb - lowest reps are logged if different.

comment.description: Commentary to the exercise if relevant.
